# User Guide

Source: working conversations with Javier G. Grandez.

A User Guide is a product artifact, not merely command reference.

It should explain what the product is, what it is for, what the user can do with it, how it is organised, how common tasks are performed, troubleshooting, and Tips & Tricks.

For `iasi-quarto`, the User Guide source lives under `docs/user-guide/` or an equivalent numbered directory such as `docs/01-user-guide/`.
